key.name: animate-transitions
key.description: Fade between views when switching messages.

key.name: window-background-path
key.description: Path to a user-picked image used as the window background; empty means the bundled artwork.

key.name: background-brightness
key.description: How bright the user-picked window background image is shown: 1.0 means no darkening, 0.0 means darkened to black. Only applies while a custom background is set.

key.name: pane-folder-width-percent
key.summary: Folder pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the folder pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-message-list-width-percent
key.summary: Message list pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the message list pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-calendar-sidebar-width-percent
key.summary: Calendar sidebar pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the calendar sidebar pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-contacts-sidebar-width-percent
key.summary: Contacts sidebar pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the contacts sidebar pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: mail-favorites
key.description: MailboxIds of folders pinned to the top of the folder tree.

key.name: mail-load-remote-images
key.description: Allow the reading pane to load image resources from remote servers.

key.name: mail-rich-text-default
key.summary: Start new messages in the formatted editor

key.name: calendar-alerts-enabled
key.description: Show a notification when an event reminder comes due.

key.name: last-view-unified
key.summary: Folder pane was on the unified view

key.name: last-view-mailbox
key.description: The MailboxId of the folder the pane reopened on; empty means none.
